continuation_status: October 19 Fort-de-France gathering (about 2,000 per AFP reporter as quoted by Le Monde) continued a movement Le Monde says had been underway since September; a September 26 France-Antilles report describes a 300–700 union-estimated march in the same cost-of-living movement. No separate October onset is asserted.

continuity.summary: Both sources describe the cost-of-living movement in Martinique; October report explicitly says continuing since September.

october_gathering.summary: About 2,000 gathered in Fort-de-France on October 19.

earlier_gathering.summary: CGTM called 26 September march, 300–700 according to union official.

notes: October unit records continuity only; onset belongs to September and must not be assigned to October.
